entries.summary: Discovery complete + design doc written; 3 hard constraints identified, baseline green (4452 tests)
entries.detail:
Model: Claude Opus 5. Branch feature/ION-16397-pi-aws-upgrade off develop@b86d536fed.

Baseline: mvn -f partner-integrator/pom.xml clean verify => BUILD SUCCESS, 4452 tests / 0 failures.
Per-module: pi-commons 1216, pi-booking-processor 2025, pi-statusevents-out 50, pi-lambda-streamToSns 16, pi-si-in 504, pi-bl-in 313, pi-si-out 264, pi-bl-es-lambda 64.

v1 surface: 104 files in src/main + 26 in src/test across 8 submodules. pi-bl-in(32)+pi-bl-es-lambda(31) are dominated by 28 DUPLICATED BL model classes (@DynamoDBDocument nested beans) present verbatim in both.

C1: commons 1.0.28-SNAPSHOT DELETES com.inttra.mercury.messaging.* entirely AND com.inttra.mercury.module.JestModule. PI imports 6 messaging symbols + JestModule.
C2: dynamo-client is NOT published at 1.0.28 (max 1.0.25) -> must be dropped, not bumped. 6 symbols across 20+ files.
C3 (blocker): 3 DynamoDB entities live in pinned external model jars.
  - booking.model.BookingDetail -> booking 3.0.0.M EXISTS, v2-annotated, git-tracked at visibility/visibility-commons/lib/. Covers 104 of 105 PI booking imports (only booking.dynamodb.DynamoSupport missing, which we delete anyway). RESOLVED.
  - visibility ContainerEvent -> v2 source in-repo (visibility-commons), buildable via -Pvisibility-model. RESOLVABLE.
  - shippinginstruction.model.SIVersion -> NO v2 jar and in-repo source is v1 (shipping-instruction pending as ION-16396). DECISION NEEDED.

DECISIVE FINDING: aws-lambda-java-events 2.x IS an AWS-SDK-v1 dependency - in 2.2.2 DynamodbEvent.DynamodbStreamRecord extends com.amazonaws.services.dynamodbv2.model.Record (v1 SDK). 3.x extends self-contained events.models.dynamodb.Record. Must normalize to 3.13.0 or 4 submodules keep dragging aws-java-sdk-dynamodb. Verified 3.13.0 getter names are identical (getS/getN/getB/getSS/getNS/getBS/getM..., getEventID/getEventName/getDynamodb) so JSON envelope shape unchanged - guarded by golden test.

Other gaps: cloud-sdk MessagingClient has NO per-message delay (3-arg overload is message attributes, verified in SqsMessagingClient source) - SQSClient.sendMessage(t,c,delay) has 9 test assertions, 0 prod callers. cloudsdk.aws.module.SQSModule/SQSReader/SQSWriter/SNSModule still expose v1 AmazonSQS/AmazonSNS - do NOT use them.

Build hygiene hazard: pi-booking-processor + pi-statusevents-out run dependency:purge-local-repository with manualInclude com.inttra.mercury:booking -> wipes ALL booking versions from ~/.m2 incl. 3.0.0.M needed by visibility-commons (observed during baseline). Narrow to the pinned coordinate.

Mirrors the existing booking/visibility lib/ convention; avoids dragging MySQL/aws-mysql-jdbc/ES-RHLC/jmockit/metrics-guice into PI's shaded jar.

DECISION booking = 3.0.0.M for all three consuming submodules (source: visibility/visibility-commons/lib/, git-tracked).

entries.summary: Baseline: 2 flaky failures in AsyncDispatcherTest (idle-count race); passes 4/4 isolated. Effectively green.
entries.detail:
Baseline `mvn -f partner-integrator/pom.xml clean verify` on develop@ac6f2f804c (no code changes yet) FAILED with exactly 2 failures, both in pi-commons AsyncDispatcherTest: testSubmit_ExceptionInTaskExecution:116 and testSubmit_ManyMessages:295 (expected <5> but was <4>). Both assert assertEquals(WORKER_THREADS, dispatcher.getIdleThreadCount()) immediately after the task latch releases / Thread.sleep(200). Root cause: race — the worker thread restores its idle count AFTER task.execute() returns, but the test's CountDownLatch counts down INSIDE execute(), so the assertion can run while one worker (of 5) is still between execute-return and idle-increment. Under full-build CPU contention this loses the race ~intermittently.

CONFIRMED FLAKY: re-ran AsyncDispatcherTest in isolation 4x -> 16 tests, 0 failures every time (mvn -f pi-commons/pom.xml test -Dtest=AsyncDispatcherTest). So baseline is effectively green (pi-commons now 1222 tests on develop vs 1216 at design time). Pre-existing on develop; NOT introduced by this migration.

PLAN: AsyncDispatcher/Task/Dispatcher are typed on com.amazonaws.services.sqs.model.Message and are on the Phase 2 retype list (design §5.2 -> QueueMessage<String>). When retyping, also make the idle-count assertions deterministic (poll getIdleThreadCount() up to a timeout) instead of asserting instantaneously — fixes flakiness without weakening the assertion.</detail>

Model: Claude Opus 4.8. Phase 1 (poms) + Phase 2 pi-commons MAIN sources DONE and COMPILING (`mvn -f partner-integrator/pom.xml -pl pi-commons compile` = BUILD SUCCESS).

Parent pom (partner-integrator/pom.xml): added properties (mercury.commons.version=1.0.31-SNAPSHOT, aws.lambda.events.version=3.13.0, jackson-bom.version=2.21.4) + dependencyManagement importing jackson-bom 2.21.4 and managing aws-lambda-java-events 3.13.0, cloud-sdk-api, cloud-sdk-aws, dynamo-integration-test(test).

pi-commons main migrated (verified signatures via javap of cloud-sdk-api/aws 1.0.31 jars):
- Converters vo.DateToEpochSecond, vo.CompressionConverter -> v2 AttributeConverter<Date>/<String> (N/S, null-safe), mirror shipping-instruction reference.
- Entities vo.SI (@Table si, KEYS_ONLY stream, id PK / sequenceNumber SK, INTTRA_REFERENCE_NUMBER_INDEX GSI+@GsiConfig KEYS_ONLY, message CompressionConverter, expiresOn DateToEpochSecond; NO @TTL to preserve live env TTL; provisioning-only, no contract field), vo.ContainerEvent (@Table container_events, id PK), vo.EnrichedAttributes (@DynamoDbBean nested). getHashKey/getSortKey kept @DynamoDbIgnore @JsonIgnore.
- REST DTOs Country/CountryIdentifier/Geography/ContainerType/PackageType: removed inert @DynamoDBDocument/@DynamoDBTypeConvertedEnum.
- S3: WorkspaceService interface putObject* -> void (no prod caller reads PutObjectResult; verified). S3WorkspaceService -> StorageClient (getObject/getContent/putObject/copyObject 6-arg), RecoverableException wrapping catch v2 SdkException, streams closed on every read path; no-charset getContent keeps BufferedReader line-join (CRLF->LF) semantics deliberately; charset getContent byte-exact via readAllBytes. AWSUtil.isRetryable -> v2 (SdkException.retryable()/RetryUtils.isThrottling/isClockSkew + IOException cause).
- SQS: SQSClient -> MessagingClient<String> sender + v2 SqsClient for the delay overload (design R5; cloud-sdk has NO per-message delay; 0 prod callers). SQSListenerClient -> MessagingClient.receiveMessages(ReceiveMessageOptions). SQSListener -> ReceiveMessageOptions + v2 AbortedException. Task/AbstractTask/TaskFactory/Dispatcher/AsyncDispatcher/TaskMessage: com.amazonaws...Message -> cloudsdk QueueMessage<String>, getBody()->getPayload(). UnrecoverableAWSException -> v2 SdkClientException.
- DELETED pi-commons DynamoSupport (v1 DynamoDBMapper helper). Still referenced by pi-bl-in/pi-si-in/pi-si-out/pi-statusevents CreateTables/DeleteTables/Injectors -> to be migrated to DynamoDbAdminCommand/per-processor DynamoModule in Phase 3.

NEXT: pi-commons TEST sources (S3WorkspaceServiceTest, SQSClientTest reference v1 AmazonSQS/PutObjectResult; AsyncDispatcher/SQSListener tests use Message). Then Phase 3 processors.</detail>

entries.summary: Table-name backward-compat: pi-booking env already has _booking (standard resolution OK); pi-statusevents special-cases BookingDetail to <prefix>_booking_booking
entries.detail:
CRITICAL table-name backward-compat facts (design §6.2/§7.4) for Phase 3 DynamoModule wiring:

BaseDynamoDbConfig.getTablePrefix() returns environment + "_" (trailing underscore) — confirmed by SI reference SIDynamoModule using clientConfig.getTablePrefix()+@Table.name() to yield <env>_si.

pi-booking-processor: config.yaml environment = inttra_int_booking / inttra2_qa_booking / inttra2_prod_booking / inttra2_test_booking (env ALREADY includes _booking). BookingDetail (booking:3.0.0.M) @Table.name()="booking". So STANDARD resolution getTablePrefix()+"booking" = "inttra_int_booking_"+"booking" = inttra_int_booking_booking. => pi-booking BookingDynamoModule can use the standard createCompositeKeyRepository(clientConfig, BookingDetail.class) — NO special-casing. BookingApplicationConfig.dynamoDbConfig type must change from com.inttra.mercury.dynamo.respository.module.DynamoDbConfig to cloudsdk.database.config.BaseDynamoDbConfig; add region to config.yaml.

pi-statusevents-out (SEFeedApplicationInjector.getNewDynamoDBMapperConfig lines 122-133): env prefix is <prefix> WITHOUT _booking; resolver SPECIAL-CASES BookingDetail -> prefixStr = prefix + "_booking"; table = <prefix>_booking_<tableName> = <prefix>_booking_booking. Everything else (ContainerEvent) -> <prefix>_<table> = <prefix>_container_events. => pi-statusevents SEFeedDynamoModule must provide BookingDao repo with tableName = clientConfig.getTablePrefix() + "booking_" + "booking" (SPECIAL), and ContainerEventDao repo with standard getTablePrefix()+@Table.name() (container_events). Need to verify pi-statusevents env value.

pi-booking BookingDao (v1 DynamoDBCrudRepository<BookingDetail, DynamoHashAndSortKey>) -> mirror booking BookingDetailDao: DatabaseRepository<BookingDetail, DefaultCompositeKey<String,String>>; query(INDEX, hash, null, "inttraReferenceNumber = :hashKeyValue") -> DefaultQuerySpec.builder().indexName(INTTRA_REFERENCE_NUMBER_INDEX).partitionKeyName("inttraReferenceNumber").partitionKeyValue(CloudAttributeValue.ofString(x)).consistentRead(false); composite find -> findById(new DefaultCompositeKey<>(bookingId, seq), true). Reference: booking/dao/BookingDetailDao.java + config/BookingDynamoModule.java (createCompositeKeyRepository helper: getTablePrefix()+@Table.name()).

pi-si-out SIDao LATENT BUG (design §5.5): extends DynamoDBCrudRepository<ContainerEvent,...> but loads SIVersion -> correct generic to SIVersion (call out in commit).</detail>

entries.summary: pi-si-in-processor DONE & green (504). 3/8 modules complete. Learning: dynamo-integration-test breaks JUnit4 modules' discovery.
entries.detail:
pi-si-in-processor DONE & GREEN: 504 tests, 0 failures (matches baseline). Changes: pom shipping-instruction 1.0.M->2.0.M via new local file repo (pi-si-in-local-repo -> file:lib), replaced si-model-s3-release repo; added cloud-sdk-api/aws; narrowed purge/get to shipping-instruction:2.0.M. SIApplicationConfig.dynamoDbConfig -> BaseDynamoDbConfig. SIApplicationInjector: removed DynamoSupport/AmazonDynamoDB/DynamoDBMapper bindings; added @Provides DynamoDbClientConfig + @Provides SIDao (createEnhancedRepository, table = getTablePrefix()+@Table.name() = <env>_si). SIDao rewritten to wrap DatabaseRepository<SIVersion, DefaultCompositeKey<String,String>>: save (UUID sortKey fallback), findByInttraReferenceNumber (GSI DefaultQuerySpec), findBySIs, findBySIId. Test files unchanged (they mock SIDao and use SIVersion no-arg/3-arg constructors that exist in v2 shipping-instruction:2.0.M).

IMPORTANT LEARNING: Adding dynamo-integration-test (test scope) to a module whose unit tests are JUnit4 breaks surefire test discovery — it pulls junit-platform onto the classpath so surefire auto-selects JUnitPlatformProvider which does NOT run JUnit4 tests (Tests run: 0). Adding junit-vintage-engine 5.11.3 then caused NoClassDefFound org/junit/platform/engine/reporting/OutputDirectoryProvider (junit-platform version conflict with what dynamo-integration-test brings). RESOLUTION for now: do NOT add dynamo-integration-test to JUnit4 modules until the IT phase; add it later WITH junit-bom alignment + junit-vintage-engine matching the platform version dynamo-integration-test uses. JUnit5 modules (pi-booking-processor) are unaffected — they keep dynamo-integration-test fine. pi-si-in tests are all JUnit4 (12 files). pi-si-out likely JUnit4/JUnit5 mix - check before adding dynamo-integration-test.

Modules DONE: pi-commons (1210), pi-booking-processor (2032), pi-si-in-processor (504). NEXT: pi-si-out-processor (widest: S3+SQS+SNS+DDB+SSM+CreateTables, fix SIDao generic bug ContainerEvent->SIVersion).</detail>

Call out the ContainerEvent->SIVersion correction in commit.

6. support/Utils.ssmParameterlookup(name): v1 AWSSimpleSystemsManagementClientBuilder.defaultClient().getParameters(...) -> ParameterStoreClientFactory.createParameterStore(AwsParameterStoreConfig.builder().region(...).credentialsProvider(...).build()); CloudParameterStore.getParameter(name, true) returns Optional<CloudParameter> (getValue()). entries.summary: Clarified events-lib version != SDK version; aligned aws-lambda-java-events to 3.14.0 (matches booking/lambda references)
entries.detail:
Clarified SDK-version vs library-version confusion and aligned aws-lambda-java-events version to the references.

KEY POINT: aws-lambda-java-events is a SEPARATE library from the AWS SDK, with its OWN version line (2.x/3.x/4.x). It is NOT 'AWS SDK v3' (Java AWS SDK only has v1 com.amazonaws.* and v2 software.amazon.awssdk.*). We upgrade the SDK v1->v2 AND separately bump aws-lambda-java-events 2.x->3.x. 'Self-contained' = in 3.x the Lambda event POJOs (DynamodbStreamRecord's Record/AttributeValue) are defined inside the events lib and depend on NO AWS SDK; in 2.x DynamodbStreamRecord extends com.amazonaws.services.dynamodbv2.model.Record (a v1 SDK class), so 2.x drags v1 back onto the classpath. Verified via javap: 2.2.2 extends dynamodbv2.model.Record; 3.13.0 AND 3.14.0 extend events.models.dynamodb.Record.

REFERENCE ALIGNMENT: booking uses aws-lambda-java-events 3.14.0; the standalone lambda module (auth-tokens-archive, registration-archive, ION-16415) uses 3.14.0. So bumping to 3.x is consistent with booking/visibility/lambda. CHANGED parent partner-integrator/pom.xml aws.lambda.events.version 3.13.0 -> 3.14.0 to match the current reference standard (July design had 3.13.0; pi-statusevents already had 3.13.0). 3.14.0 confirmed present in ~/.m2 and self-contained. This change is uncommitted on top of WIP commit c417d7edaa - fold into the single ION-16397 commit (git commit --amend) and re-snapshot backup branch with git push --force-with-lease if a fresh off-disk copy is wanted. Doc §14 rewritten with the two-libraries table + reference-version note; other doc mentions updated 3.13.0->3.14.0 (historical bump/drift mentions kept).</detail>
